records.title: Union authorisation granted for Neporex 2SG, valid to 2035
records.summary: Elanco won an EU-wide authorisation for its cyromazine fly-control product, running to 31 January 2035. The expensive route, pursued since 2017 and cleared by the BPC in 2024.

signal.label: Strong
signal.rationale: Best evidence against non-renewal, and the most recent substantive record. An authorisation to 2035 cannot outlive a substance approval expiring 2027.
